signature.why: The combo, and the only place in Modern these two cards appear together: Broodscale makes an Eldrazi Spawn when a +1/+1 counter arrives, Blade puts a counter on it when a creature dies, and sacrificing the Spawn for mana closes the loop for infinite mana and infinite bodies. 10/10 current field lists run 4 and 3.

The colorless Eldrazi engine the combo is built inside, 4-of in 10/10 field lists. Rumble digs for the missing half, Kozilek's Command makes Spawn to sacrifice or exiles a blocker, and Eldrazi Temple pays for all of it.

The green-artifact half. Ancient Stirrings finds Broodscale, Blade, a land or a Drum and is 4-of in 10/10, and Urza's Saga assembles the Blade side outright. It is what separates this from eldrazi ramp, which runs the same Temple engine and none of these.
